item.title: Kazakhstan Calls for Freezing Russia-Ukraine War as Drone Attacks Halt Oil Exports
item.description: 🇰🇿🛢️ Kazakhstan Calls for Freezing Russia-Ukraine War as Drone Attacks Halt Oil Exports — President Tokayev urged freezing the Russia-Ukraine conflict beside Putin in Omsk, while Kazakhstan slashed oil production after Ukrainian drone attacks forced its main Black Sea export terminal to shut down.

item.title: Lebanon Accuses Israel of Obstructing Troop Deployment in Southern Pilot Zones
item.description: 🇱🇧⚔️ Lebanon Accuses Israel of Obstructing Troop Deployment in Southern Pilot Zones — The Lebanese army says Israel is violating withdrawal agreements by continuing shellings and bulldozing operations, preventing Lebanese forces from taking over pilot zone villages in the south.

item.title: Netanyahu Vows to Visit New York Despite ICC Warrant, Accuses Mayor Mamdani of Fomenting Hate
item.description: 🇮🇱🏛️ Netanyahu Vows to Visit New York Despite ICC Warrant, Accuses Mayor Mamdani of Fomenting Hate — The Israeli PM said he will speak at the UN General Assembly this fall, calling ICC war crimes charges bogus and accusing NYC Mayor Mamdani of turning groups against each other. Mamdani had previously threatened to arrest Netanyahu.

item.title: New UK PM Burnham Pledges Unwavering Ukraine Support Ahead of Zelensky Visit
item.description: 🇬🇧🇺🇦 New UK PM Burnham Pledges Unwavering Ukraine Support Ahead of Zelensky Visit — Andy Burnham announced sharing of the UK's Stone Cloak electronic warfare IP with Ukraine as President Zelensky becomes the new prime minister's first international visitor at a naval base meeting.

item.title: Israeli Settlers Set Fire to Mosques and Farmland in West Bank Amid Escalating Violence
item.description: 🇵🇸🔥 Israeli Settlers Set Fire to Mosques and Farmland in West Bank Amid Escalating Violence — Settlers attacked two villages overnight, burning mosques under construction and vandalizing property, following a deadly clash in Tal village that killed four Palestinians and two Israelis.

item.title: Romania shoots down third Russian drone in three days, summons ambassador
item.description: 🇷🇴 Romania shoots down third Russian drone in three days, summons ambassador — Romania shot down a third drone in as many days over the Black Sea and summoned Russia's ambassador over repeated airspace violations. The incidents raise fears of the Ukraine war spilling over into NATO territory, with Romania's president identifying at least one drone as a Russian Shahed model.

item.title: US pauses Iran attacks for second night as military advised Trump to halt bombing
item.description: 🇺🇸🇮🇷 US pauses Iran attacks for second night as military advised Trump to halt bombing — The US has paused strikes on Iran for a second consecutive night after top military officials warned Trump that the campaign had reached the limits of its effectiveness and munitions stockpiles were dwindling. Iran also halted retaliatory attacks. Diplomatic talks over the Strait of Hormuz continue amid fears of energy supply disruption.

item.title: Israel launches military incursion into Syria as UN chief demands withdrawal
item.description: 🇮🇱🇸🇾 Israel launches military incursion into Syria as UN chief demands withdrawal — Israeli forces advanced into villages in southwestern Syria, setting up checkpoints and dropping leaflets warning residents, as UN Secretary-General Guterres visited Damascus and condemned violations of Syria's sovereignty. Guterres called for all sanctions on Syria to be lifted immediately.

item.title: Berlin Pride attack suspect shot and killed by police during manhunt
item.description: 🇩🇪 Berlin Pride attack suspect shot and killed by police during manhunt — German police shot and killed Abdul Ballout, the 21-year-old suspected of driving a van into a Berlin Pride crowd and stabbing people, killing one woman and injuring at least 29. Authorities called it a likely Islamist terror attack. Germany raised its threat level in response.

item.title: More than 360,000 evacuated as record wildfires ravage France and Spain
item.description: 🔥 More than 360,000 evacuated as record wildfires ravage France and Spain — Wildfires in southwestern France and Spain have forced over 360,000 people to flee their homes, with 55,000 evacuated overnight near Bordeaux alone. France has seen 42,000 hectares burned in one of its largest fires since WWII. Spain declared a national emergency as fires spread toward Madrid and Valencia.

item.title: Hezbollah says Iran will not sign final deal unless Israel withdraws from Lebanon
item.description: 🇱🇧🇮🇷 Hezbollah says Iran will not sign final deal unless Israel withdraws from Lebanon — Hezbollah stated Iran has pledged not to sign a final nuclear deal with Washington unless Israel withdraws from Lebanon, as Iran's foreign minister called Israel's continued troop presence a breach of the US-Iran memorandum of understanding.

item.title: The Iran war permanently altered the global economy
item.description: 💰🌍 The Iran war permanently altered the global economy — The global economic order has been reshaped by the US-Iran conflict, with shifts in oil markets, trade routes, and supply chains that are unlikely to simply revert to pre-war patterns even as a peace deal emerges.

item.title: Zelenskiy says G7 agreed Russia is not winning the war, discussed more sanctions
item.description: 🇺🇦🇷🇺 Zelenskiy says G7 agreed Russia is not winning the war, discussed more sanctions — Ukrainian President Zelenskiy said G7 leaders agreed at the France summit that Russia is not winning its war in Ukraine and discussed additional sanctions to bring Moscow to negotiations.

item.title: Trump says Iran deal makes clear Tehran will never have a nuclear weapon
item.description: 🇺🇸🇮🇷 Trump says Iran deal makes clear Tehran will never have a nuclear weapon — President Trump maintained the interim accord with Iran makes clear Tehran would never be allowed to develop a nuclear weapon, and suggested Syria could be better positioned to disarm Hezbollah.

item.title: EU lawmakers set to approve tougher migrant detention and deportation rules
item.description: 🇪🇺 EU lawmakers set to approve tougher migrant detention and deportation rules — European lawmakers are giving final approval to stricter migration rules that grant authorities broader powers to detain irregular arrivals and create expanded deportation facilities. The measures represent a significant hardening of EU migration policy amid rising anti-immigration sentiment across the bloc.

item.title: Israeli army prepares for prolonged Lebanon occupation despite US-Iran peace pact
item.description: 🇮🇱🇱🇧 Israeli army prepares for prolonged Lebanon occupation despite US-Iran peace pact — Security sources report that Israeli troops remain ready to stay in occupied Lebanese territory if instructed by political leadership, even as the US-Iran peace deal moves toward signing. The stance contradicts Iranian FM Araghchi's demand for Israeli withdrawal from Lebanon as part of any agreement.

item.title: UN chief Guterres visits Haiti as gang violence deepens humanitarian crisis
item.description: 🇭🇹 UN chief Guterres visits Haiti as gang violence deepens humanitarian crisis — UN Secretary-General Antonio Guterres visited Haiti as gang violence continues to worsen the country's humanitarian crisis, with thousands displaced and basic services collapsing. The visit highlights international concern over the Caribbean nation's descent into chaos.

item.title: Singapore May exports surge 38% driven by AI-related demand
item.description: 🇸🇬 Singapore May exports surge 38% driven by AI-related demand — Singapore's non-oil domestic exports jumped 38.4% year-on-year in May, fueled by robust AI-related shipments. The surge signals sustained Asian tech supply chain momentum even amid global trade uncertainties from US tariff policies and geopolitical tensions.

item.title: Israeli minister announces military takeover of Hebron administration
item.description: 🇮🇱 Israeli minister announces military takeover of Hebron administration — Israeli Finance Minister Bezalel Smotrich says Israel has transferred authority over Hebron to the army, a significant escalation in West Bank control that could further complicate regional peace efforts.

item.title: Brazilian court convicts Eduardo Bolsonaro for seeking US interference in domestic affairs
item.description: 🇧🇷 Brazilian court convicts Eduardo Bolsonaro for seeking US interference in domestic affairs — A Brazilian court found Eduardo Bolsonaro guilty of attempting to enlist US government interference in Brazil, a case tied to broader tensions between Brasilia and Washington over tariffs and judicial sanctions.

item.title: Damaged Kyiv monastery from Russian strike will take two years to restore
item.description: 🇺🇦 Damaged Kyiv monastery from Russian strike will take two years to restore — Ukrainian officials say the nearly 1,000-year-old monastery in Kyiv, damaged by what Ukraine described as a deliberate Russian strike, requires around two years of restoration work.

item.title: Anti-capitalist protesters descend on G7 summit in France
item.description: 🇫🇷 Anti-capitalist protesters descend on G7 summit in France — Anti-capitalist demonstrations unfolded at the G7 summit in Evian-les-Bains as world leaders discussed global security, the Iran deal, and economic policy inside the heavily secured venue.

item.title: G7 leaders discuss granting trusted partners access to cutting-edge US AI models
item.description: 🤖 G7 leaders discuss granting trusted partners access to cutting-edge US AI models — G7 leaders discussed a plan to grant select trusted partners access to advanced AI models from US firms such as Anthropic, three diplomatic sources said, potentially opening a path around restrictions on non-American use of the technology.

item.title: Israeli drone strikes kill at least 4 in southern Lebanon
item.description: 🇱🇧 Israeli drone strikes kill at least 4 in southern Lebanon — Israeli drone strikes targeted three vehicles in southern Lebanon, killing at least four people and wounding others, Lebanons National News Agency reported. The strikes come amid ongoing tensions even as the US-Iran peace deal raises hopes for regional de-escalation.

item.title: Trump-backed candidate loses Georgia governor runoff in upset
item.description: 🇺🇸 Trump-backed candidate loses Georgia governor runoff in upset — Georgia Republican voters rejected President Trumps preferred nominee for the competitive open governor race, delivering a rare primary endorsement defeat. Rep. Mike Collins won the Republican Senate runoff and will face Sen. Jon Ossoff in a closely watched matchup.
